第1441章勒马未及
“敬酒不吃吃罚酒，既然你冥顽不灵，那就别怪我不客气了，接下来的一切，都是你咎由自取！”
玄华的脸色彻底冷了下来，她闭上眼睛，彻底下了决心。
“青灵，无论如何我都要救你，一切后果都由我来承担，愿命运保佑你！”
再度睁开眼时，她的瞳孔中已经充满了决绝之色。
“虚空听令，转移！”
下一刻，整片反抗军的基地都在震动，这里是由她开辟出来的大圣空间，毫无疑问，她就是此处的主宰。
无穷的空间之力奔涌而来，顷刻间，吞没了此片区域。
周通面色不变，道行内敛，彻底锁在了躯体之内，压着那无比浑厚浩瀚的法则，阻止其自动触发，进行镇压的本能。
眨眼的功夫，周围的场景就变了，周通与反抗军的一众高层来到了一片广场。
放眼望去，这片广场甚是宽敞，只不过早已落满了灰尘，充满了陈旧的痕迹，仿佛被遗弃在了这里。
广场的中心，一个祭坛赫然醒目，造型极为独特，由三个扇形的部分组成，拼接成了一个完整的圆。
下一刻，无识之境触发，瞬间读懂了其精髓。
“好一个外源阵法，的确可以代替搜魂秘术了，还真是魔高一尺，道高一丈。”
周通都忍不住在心中赞叹，天道垄断了搜魂之术，恐怕就是为了防止自己的走狗败露，同时死守住秘密。
只是没想到上有政策，下有对策，反抗军见招拆招，找出了破解之法。
祭坛的三部分，分别映照着天地人，同时也对应着精气神，周围布有七道阵眼，灵气归位之后开始运转。
若是有七位圣王把阵，就可以抽丝剥茧，破解被搜魂之人的一切信息，而后进行编译，得出任何想要的答案。
这样的搜魂秘术，简单，霸道而且极为准确！
被强行探查的人不会有丝毫隐瞒，即便是自己忘记的事情，都会被强行重塑，而后呈现出来。

但这样的副作用是巨大的，会给被搜魂之人留下难以磨灭的损伤，甚至直接重伤垂死也不算是意外。
“上去吧…”
两位圣王一左一右，按住了周通的肩膀，步履间隐有肃杀之气，将其带上了祭坛。
紧接着，就随其余的四个圣王各自归位，分别把住了六道阵眼。
最后一道主阵眼，玄华一步踏出，浩瀚的灵气狂涌而出，彻底将其激活。
“此阵一旦运转，就彻底不能回头了，你知道你将面临什么吗？”
临门一脚，玄华强制静止，就觉得在自己的面前摆着一道浑厚的壁垒，阻止着她继续往下踏去。
前方就是无尽的深渊！
这道壁垒，是她曾经发下的誓言，也有着对青灵的牵挂，同时还有对反抗军的不舍以及浓郁到化不开的绝望。
只要踏出去，祭台上的那个人就会被毁掉，而自己也将万劫不复。
反抗军失去了她，恐怕也会在很长的一段时间内一蹶不振，如果再被天道所趁，说不定会直接全灭！
每一个后果，都沉重的难以承受。
她是真的进退维谷，生死两难。
一开始，她被暴怒支配着，认定周通是罪魁祸首，要让其生不如死。
第1441章勒马未及
再见到周通时，她想用强势逼人，希望能够吓到对方，让其老实交代，这是对她而言最好的情况。
然而对方完全不吃压力，脾气硬的如同钢块，捶不扁砸不烂，最后将她硬生生的架到了这里！

Chapter 1441: Not in time to rein in the horse
"If you don't eat the toast, you will be fined with wine. Since you are so stubborn, don't blame me for being rude. Everything that happens next is your own fault!"
Xuanhua's face turned completely cold, she closed her eyes and made up her mind completely.
"Qing Ling, I will save you no matter what, and I will bear all the consequences. May fate bless you!"
When she opened her eyes again, her pupils were filled with determination.
"Void listens to orders, transfer!"
The next moment, the entire resistance base was shaking. This was the Great Holy Space created by her. There was no doubt that she was the master here.
Infinite power of space rushed in and swallowed up this area in an instant.
Zhou Tong's expression remained unchanged, his Taoism was restrained, and he was completely locked within his body, suppressing the extremely profound and vast laws, preventing them from automatically triggering and suppressing his instinct.
In the blink of an eye, the surrounding scene changed. Zhou Tong and a group of high-ranking officials from the resistance army arrived at a square.
Looking at it, this square is very spacious, but it is already covered with dust and full of traces of antiquity, as if it had been abandoned here.
In the center of the square, an altar stands out with a very unique shape. It is composed of three fan-shaped parts, spliced ​​into a complete circle.
The next moment, the realm of ignorance was triggered, and I instantly understood its essence.
"What an external formation. It can indeed replace the soul-searching secret technique. It is really as good as the magic and the Tao."
Zhou Tong couldn't help but admire in his heart that Tiandao had monopolized the soul-searching technique, probably just to prevent his lackeys from being exposed and at the same time to keep the secret tightly.
But I didn't expect that there were policies from above and countermeasures from below. The resistance army saw the tricks and found a way to crack it.
The three parts of the altar reflect the heaven, earth and people respectively, and also correspond to the spirit, energy and spirit. There are seven formation eyes around it. After the spiritual energy returns to its position, it starts to operate.
If there are seven holy kings in charge, they can peel off all the information about the person whose soul is being searched, and then compile it to get any desired answer.
This soul-searching secret technique is simple, domineering and extremely accurate!
People who are forcibly probed will not hide anything. Even things they have forgotten will be forcibly reshaped and then presented.
But such side effects are huge and will leave indelible damage to the person whose soul is being searched. Even being directly seriously injured and dying is not an accident.
"Go up..."
The two holy kings, one on the left and one on the right, held Zhou Tong's shoulders, with a chilling air in their steps, and brought him to the altar.
Immediately afterwards, the remaining four holy kings returned to their respective positions and held the six formation eyes respectively.
Xuanhua stepped forward with the last main formation eye, and vast spiritual energy surged out, completely activating it.
"Once this formation is in operation, there will be no turning back. Do you know what you will face?"
With the final kick, Xuanhua was forced to remain still, feeling that there was a thick barrier in front of her, preventing her from stepping further down.
Ahead is an endless abyss!
This barrier is the oath she once swore, and it also contains her concern for Qing Ling, as well as her reluctance to let go of the resistance and the despair that is so rich that it cannot be resolved.
As long as he steps out, the person on the altar will be destroyed, and he will be beyond redemption.
If the resistance army loses her, I'm afraid it will be in ruins for a long time. If it is taken advantage of by the law of heaven again, it may be completely wiped out!
Every consequence is too heavy to bear.
She was really in a dilemma, between life and death.
At first, she was dominated by rage, identifying Zhou Tong as the culprit, and wanted to make his life worse than death.
Chapter 1441: Not in time to rein in the horse
When she saw Zhou Tong again, she wanted to force him, hoping to scare him into confessing honestly. This was the best situation for her.
However, the other party did not take any pressure at all, and his temper was as hard as a steel block, which could not be beaten flat or smashed. In the end, she wasIt’s hard to get here!
